summary: Lufax Holding Ltd filed a Form 6-K furnishing a Hong Kong-style shareholder circular and proxy card for an extraordinary general meeting to be held October 8, 2026 in Shanghai. The sole agenda item is a connected transaction: approval of an extension to the maturity date of the Ping An Overseas Holdings convertible promissory notes. The board has formed an independent board committee, and an independent financial adviser opines on the transaction. This is an ordinary related-party financing maturity extension, not a special situation; proxy mechanics require receipt by October 6, 2026.
